claims.claim: 速效救心丸为川芎与冰片制成的专利中成药，功效为理气活血，可增加冠脉血流量、改善心肌细胞缺氧、缓解心绞痛。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill (SJP, produced by Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical Group Co, Ltd.) is a patented drug made of active ingredients from Chuanxiong and Borneol, and it has the effect of regulating Qi and promoting blood circulation. SJP can increase coronary blood flow, improve myocardial cell hypoxia, and relieve angina pectoris similar to nitroglycerin
claims.applicability: 直接：描述本品成分与功效来源，为临床试验方案背景表述，间接转述说明书功效
claims.uncertainty: 来源于临床试验方案背景段，非 NMPA 说明书原文；成分表述（Chuanxiong/Borneol 与 tetramethylpyrazine/borneol）在同一文件内存在两种写法

claims.claim: 速效救心丸含四甲基吡嗪（川芎嗪）与冰片，中国国家药监局批准文号为 Z12020025，每丸重 40 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: SJP is composed of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol approval number Z12020025 of the China State Food and Drug Administration [SFDA]). … Each pill weighs 40 mg.
claims.applicability: 直接：批准文号与规格为可核验标识，出自已发表试验方案
claims.uncertainty: 批准文号转引自试验方案，历次修订日期未在本文件载明；官方现行说明书文本未在本次检索中独立核验

claims.claim: 速效救心丸的随机对照试验纳入对象限定为 18 至 80 岁、已确诊冠心病、中医辨证为气滞血瘀证的稳定型心绞痛患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: Age 18 to 80 years; … Diagnosed with CHD; … TCM diagnosis of Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome; and
claims.applicability: 直接：以该 RCT 的纳入标准界定本品研究人群，区分'已确诊冠心病+辨证'与'无诊断'人群
claims.uncertainty: 为试验纳入标准，不等同于说明书适应症原文；RCT 结果尚未在可检索全文范围内获得

claims.claim: 该随机对照试验明确排除由精神病、严重神经症、甲亢、胆心综合征、胃食管反流、主动脉夹层等其他疾病引起的胸痛。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: Chest pain caused by other diseases, such as psychosis, severe neurosis, hyperthyroidism, biliary heart syndrome, gastroesophageal reflux, and aortic dissection;
claims.applicability: 直接：支持'非心源性、精神性胸痛不在本品研究人群内'的判断
claims.uncertainty: 此为排除标准而非禁忌，但直接表明研究未覆盖非心源性与精神源性胸痛人群

claims.claim: 该试验主要结局为心绞痛疗效与心血管事件复合终点（心源性死亡、非致死性心肌梗死、血运重建、心力衰竭、因冠心病住院），未将无诊断人群的心源性猝死预防设为结局。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: The primary outcome is the effect in angina pectoris, a composite endpoint of cardiovascular events (cardiac death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, revascularization with PCI or coronary artery bypass graft, heart failure, and hospitalization for coronary heart disease).
claims.applicability: 直接：界定本品已发表研究可支持的结局层级（症状疗效与心血管事件复合终点，均限于已确诊冠心病人群）
claims.uncertainty: 为方案预设结局，试验结果全文未在本次检索中获得；'心源性猝死预防'在无诊断人群无对应研究

claims.claim: 多数胸痛并非严重疾病的征象，但仍应寻求医疗评估。
claims.supportQuote: Most chest pain is not a sign of anything serious but get medical advice just in case.
claims.applicability: 直接：面向公众的胸痛就医指引，界定'多数胸痛非严重'与'仍应就医'的边界
claims.uncertainty: 英国卫生系统公众页，非临床指南；'多数'为面向一般人群的通俗表述，不适用于已出现警示征象者

claims.claim: 出现突发持续不缓解的胸痛，或胸痛伴出汗、恶心、头晕、气促时，须立即呼叫急救电话。
claims.supportQuote: Immediate action required: Call 999 if: … you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away … you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath
claims.applicability: 直接：急救呼叫条件，可在我国本地化为 120；来源原文为英国 999
claims.uncertainty: 原文为英国急救号码 999；转述为我国场景时应替换为 120，症状条件本身不变

claims.claim: 胸痛有诸多病因，多数情况下并非心脏问题所致，且不应当自行诊断。
claims.supportQuote: In most cases, chest pain is not caused by a heart problem. … Do not self-diagnose – see a GP if you're worried.
claims.applicability: 直接：支持'胸痛多数非心源性'及'不可自行诊断/归因'的表述
claims.uncertainty: 公众健康教育页，非诊断工具；不排除个别需要急诊评估的器质性病因

claims.claim: 瑞典全国 0–35 岁肥厚型心肌病猝死队列中，71% 死前曾出现可能的心源性症状（胸痛 26%、晕厥 22%、心悸 37%），69% 在死前 180 天内曾就医。
claims.sourceTitle: Symptoms and ECG changes precede sudden cardiac death in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy—A nationwide study among the young in Sweden
claims.supportQuote: Thirty-eight cases (7 female), mean age 22 years, with HCM were identified. Among these, 71% presented with possible cardiac symptoms (chest pain [26%], syncope [22%], palpitations [37%]), before death; 69% received medical care (vs 21% in controls) within 180 days before death. … The SUDDY database (The Swedish study of SUDden cardiac Death in the Young) comprises 903 individuals that died from SCD in Sweden aged 0–35, from January 1, 2000 until December 31, 2010
claims.applicability: 直接：青年（0–35 岁）猝死前驱症状比例；限于 HCM 病因，不覆盖全部猝死病因
claims.uncertainty: 单病因（HCM）队列、n=38；症状比例来自事后回顾，存在回忆偏倚，不能外推为所有青年猝死的前驱症状谱

claims.claim: 该队列的症状资料系回顾性收集（医疗记录与亲属访谈），可能高估症状与猝死的关联。
claims.sourceTitle: Symptoms and ECG changes precede sudden cardiac death in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy—A nationwide study among the young in Sweden
claims.supportQuote: Even though, inevitably, all information had to be collected retrospectively, this might cause an over-interpretation of possible cardiac symptoms when reviewing medical records as well as interviewing relatives (recall bias).
claims.applicability: 直接：作者自述的偏倚方向，支撑'回顾性比例≠前瞻预测效能'的方法学判断
claims.uncertainty: 作者陈述的局限，本身即证据；据此任何敏感度/特异度/阳性预测值均无法推算

claims.claim: 葡萄牙 1–40 岁人群 5 年内登记 159 例突发死亡，年发病率为每 10 万人·年 2,4 例（95%CI 1,5–3,6），70,4% 为心源性，最常见心源性诊断为动脉粥样硬化性冠状动脉疾病（33,0%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Sudden death in young South European population: a cross-sectional study of postmortem cases
claims.supportQuote: (ages 1–40: 26% of the total population) … During a 5-year period, 159 SD were identified, corresponding to an annual incidence of 2,4 (95%confidence interval, 1,5–3,6) per 100.000 people-years. … There were 70,4% cardiac, 16,4% respiratory and 7,5% neurologic causes of SD. The most frequent cardiac anatomopathological diagnosis was atherosclerotic coronary artery disease (CAD) (33,0%).
claims.applicability: 直接：1–40 岁人群突发死亡的发生率与病因分布（尸检系列，有分母）；葡萄牙人群，非中国
claims.uncertainty: 葡萄牙尸检登记，中国人群适用性受限；2,4/10万·年为原文以逗号小数表述；病因归类受病理诊断不确定（30,4% 为意义不明的病理发现）影响

claims.claim: 坦桑尼亚急诊前瞻性队列中，非创伤性胸痛患者的心衰与肺结核为最主要出院诊断（各 12.6%），急性冠脉综合征仅占 9.6%，显示病因构成随就诊场景与地区差异极大。
claims.sourceTitle: Non-traumatic chest pain in patients presenting to an urban emergency Department in sub Saharan Africa: a prospective cohort study in Tanzania
claims.supportQuote: Heart failure and pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) were the leading hospital diagnoses (12.6% each), followed by chronic kidney disease (10%) and acute coronary syndrome (ACS) (9.6%).
claims.applicability: 间接：前瞻性队列、有诊断随访；人群为撒哈拉以南非洲成人，非青年、非中国
claims.uncertainty: 间接人群与场景，用于说明'病因构成因场景而异、无单一数字'，不用于中国青年外推

claims.claim: 该胸痛队列纳入 349 例 18 岁及以上成人，中位年龄 45 岁，其中 60% 在 50 岁以下，其年龄结构并非以青年为主。
claims.sourceTitle: Non-traumatic chest pain in patients presenting to an urban emergency Department in sub Saharan Africa: a prospective cohort study in Tanzania
claims.supportQuote: We screened 29,495 adults patients 18 years and above who presented to the EMD during the study period … Of the 349 patients enrolled, median age was 45 years, (IQR: 29–60) years, and 60% were under 50 years old.
claims.applicability: 直接：说明现有胸痛队列的年龄结构，界定其对青年人群问题的间接性
claims.uncertainty: '18–45 岁'为本评价目标人群的界定，该队列原文按 18 岁及以上纳入、未按 18–45 岁分层报告；年龄分层数据未在摘要层级展开，该队列整体年龄高于青年人群

claims.claim: 该队列中 87% (33/38) 的病例死前已有异常表现（心脏症状、阳性家族史、已知心脏病或心电图异常），68% 死于娱乐活动或运动或竞技运动中。
claims.sourceTitle: Symptoms and ECG changes precede sudden cardiac death in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy—A nationwide study among the young in Sweden
claims.supportQuote: The majority (68%) died during recreational activity (n = 14) or exercise/competitive sports (n = 12). … In this comprehensive, nationwide study of SCD due to HCM, 87% (33/38) of cases had one or more abnormality prior to death, including cardiac symptoms, a positive family history, known cardiac disease or ECG abnormalities.
claims.applicability: 直接：同一队列中'死前已有异常'与'死亡发生于运动或娱乐活动中'的比例，支撑警示征象与运动相关性的表述
claims.uncertainty: 单一病因（HCM）队列；比例为事后回顾，与前瞻预测效能无关

claims.claim: 青年心源性猝死的前驱症状比例来自事后回溯（医疗记录与亲属访谈）与尸检登记，而非有分母的前瞻随访；据此无法计算胸闷症状对随后猝死的敏感度、特异度、阳性预测值与绝对风险。
claims.applicability: 综合判断：两篇已读全文均为回顾性/尸检设计，共同界定现有证据的形式边界
claims.uncertainty: 未检索到以'有胸闷症状的青年人群'为分母的前瞻随访研究；此为证据缺口而非'已证实无预测价值'

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Symptoms and ECG changes precede sudden cardiac death in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy—A nationwide study among the young in Sweden
supportingSources.supportQuote: Even though, inevitably, all information had to be collected retrospectively, this might cause an over-interpretation of possible cardiac symptoms when reviewing medical records as well as interviewing relatives (recall bias).

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Sudden death in young South European population: a cross-sectional study of postmortem cases
supportingSources.supportQuote: In a cross-sectional study, we retrospectively reviewed cases from the database of the Portuguese Institute of Legal Medicine and Forensic Sciences (INMLCF, I.P.) of individuals who underwent an autopsy between January 2012 and December 2016 (5-year period)

claims.claim: 由回顾性病例系列中的胸痛症状比例（如 HCM 队列 26%）不能推算其预测效能，因为阳性预测值 = 有胸痛者中随后猝死者 ÷ 有胸痛者总数，而回顾性系列仅提供分子（38 例猝死者中 10 例有胸痛），缺乏'同期有胸痛但未猝死'的分母。
claims.method: 阳性预测值的定义式 PPV=TP/(TP+FP)。以 CLM-010 报告的 38 例 HCM 猝死者中胸痛 26%（10/38）作为分子示例：分母需为'有胸痛症状的青年总人数'，而该回顾性队列只纳入了已猝死者，未纳入同期有症状但存活的对照症状人数，故 TP 与 FP 均无法从该数据获得，敏感度/特异度/PPV/绝对风险均不可计算。
claims.assumptions: 胸痛 26% 取自 38 例已猝死 HCM 病例的事后医疗记录与亲属访谈，代表'猝死者中曾有胸痛者占比'，不等于'有胸痛者中会猝死者占比'。
claims.sensitivity: 若未来获得以有胸痛青年为分母的前瞻队列，且事件率极低（年发病率约 2–5/10 万人·年），则任何单一症状的阳性预测值都将接近零，提示预警效能的评估应以复合警示征象与风险分层而非单一症状为前提。
claims.applicability: 推导性结论：回答'两类证据可推出的结论有何区别'这一方法论问题
claims.uncertainty: 本推导不引入新的经验数字，仅以已引文献的数值说明分母缺失的逻辑后果；不能据此得出任何症状'有'或'无'预测价值的经验结论
